name: Bot detection and CAPTCHA signals
plain: Anti-bot services combine many browser and network signals to guess if the visitor is automated.
meaning: Inputs include navigator.webdriver, headless user agents and CDP side effects, JA3/JA4 and HTTP/2 mismatches, canvas and WebGL consistency, mouse and key timing, IP reputation and challenge solving (Turnstile, reCAPTCHA, hCaptcha).

web.api: navigator.webdriver; challenge scripts; fingerprints; Privacy Pass tokens

steps: Collect signals and run proof of work or checks
Server scores and issues a clearance cookie or token

limits.headline: Can combine many browser and network clues to guess if you are a bot
limits.user_action: Nothing. It happens as the page loads, and sometimes when you solve a challenge
can: Check for signs of automation, such as odd browser details or headless modes
Compare your network and browser fingerprints for mismatches
Watch mouse and key timing and your IP reputation
Show a challenge such as Turnstile, reCAPTCHA or hCaptcha
cannot: Know your name from these clues alone
Be sure; real people can be flagged and bots can slip through
See your files or other tabs
Work the same on every site; each service picks its own signals

story.what_it_is: Sites combine many hidden clues to guess whether you are a person or a program.

marketing.name: Turnstile
marketing.pitch: Cloudflare pitches a CAPTCHA alternative that checks signals quietly so most visitors never see a puzzle.

marketing.name: reCAPTCHA
marketing.pitch: Google describes risk scoring that decides if a visitor is human with little or no interaction.

story.for_you: Most of the time you notice nothing. Sometimes you see a puzzle, a 'verify you are human' box, or a short wait. Behind it, a bot defense reads your browser, network and behavior.
story.for_makers: Makers fight fake accounts, scalpers, scraping and click fraud. They read browser quirks, network details and mouse patterns. This helps stop bots, but the same signals can also act as a fingerprint.

use_cases.example: A game login or shop uses a bot check so cheat sellers cannot mass create accounts.
An online ticket or loot drop page blocks bots so real players can buy limited items.
A sneaker or concert ticket sale blocks scalper bots at checkout.
An ad platform filters fake clicks so advertisers do not pay for bots.
A bank or login page scores each visit by browser, network and behavior before it asks for a password.
A publisher removes bot visits so traffic reports show real readers.
A social site stops mass fake sign ups and spam.

technical_bounds: Arms race: stealth tools and residential proxies bypass many checks
False positives for privacy tools and accessibility users

value.legit_uses: Fraud, scraping and credential stuffing defense
value.abuse: Excludes privacy tools; collects extensive fingerprints

history.change: Cloudflare Turnstile launched as a CAPTCHA alternative
Apple Private Access Tokens announced at WWDC
